## Activity

During July 2021, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 304 captures. This represents the activity reported for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results below. The captures were submitted for review through the clinic’s normal operational process.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 9 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 3.0. These captures could not support a grading outcome and are reported separately from the images that proceeded to grading. The result should be considered alongside the overall capture activity recorded at West Gate Eye Clinic during July 2021.

## Grading

Grading identified 67 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1. This provides the reported measure of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process. Together, the referable results, the ungradable captures, and the median lag summarise the grading position for West Gate Eye Clinic in July 2021.
